limitations: Complete bipartite graph and equal random priority on all length-two paths only.
The probability limit assumes a nonzero fixed relative imbalance; the critical law assumes square-root imbalance.
No critical-window moment convergence, finite-size rate, intermediate-imbalance law, or priority over all possible urn formulations is claimed.
title: Quartic-root critical jamming in random length-two-path adsorption on complete bipartite graphs
